parole.significato: simple, primitive shoes made of one piece of leather without seams and with straps or laces on top
parole.testo: This word, already mentioned in 14th-century texts, is traditionally considered a borrowing from Russian посто́лы (postóly) (dialectal), itself apparently a borrowing from Turkish postal (“shoe”), from post (“skin, leather”).
